responsibility: Defines the IA-64 target command-line options and their mapping to backend variables and masks. It introduces endianness, toolchain, PIC/GP, inline divide and sqrt strategy, TLS immediate size, register naming, small-data usage, scheduling/speculation controls, and mtune handling, making this file the generated option-table source that feeds both driver and cc1 target option processing for the port.
same_name_distinction: The generated-options definition file for IA-64: unlike ia64.h, ia64.cc, and ia64.md, it does not describe architecture macros, implement backend logic, or define RTL instruction patterns; it declares target switches, enums, masks, and option variables such as endianness, TLS size, tuning, and scheduling controls.
